steps.label: encode
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/euv_main" && n=$(ls r | wc -l); echo frames $n; [ $n -ge 1588 ] || exit 1; cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -framerate 25 -i "$AGENT_HOME/work/euv_main/r/f%04d.jpg" -i "$AGENT_HOME/work/euv_main/euv_mix.m4a" -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 21 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a copy -shortest -movflags +faststart "$AGENT_HOME/work/euv_main/euv_mt.mp4" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i "$AGENT_HOME/work/euv_main/euv_mt.mp4" -vf scale=1280:720 -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 25 -c:a aac -b:a 160k -movflags +faststart "$AGENT_HOME/work/euv_main/euv_720.mp4" && ls -l "$AGENT_HOME/work/euv_main/"*.mp4

steps.label: push
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/euv_main" && "$AGENT_HOME/node/bin/node" "$AGENT_HOME/repo/tools/push_preview.mjs" euv_mt.mp4 euv/final/euv_mt_1080.mp4 euv_720.mp4 euv/final/euv_mt_720.mp4 rall.log euv/final/rall.log
